descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
🌿 Yoga Hands-Free VR

Move with your hands. Move with your body. A yoga-inspired VR learning experience using hand-tracking only, designed for comfort and natural motion. No controllers. Just you.

The app features three difficulty levels:

🌟Beginner – Gentle, easy-to-follow poses
🌟Intermediate – Moderate sequences to improve flexibility
🌟Advanced – More challenging movements for experienced users

Across these levels, the app includes about 80 yoga poses, stretches, and sequence-based exercises.

✨ Key Features

👀 Interactive 3D Instructor
Rotate your AI instructor to any angle with a simple finger swipe. Watch every detail from the perfect perspective — just like training with a personal tutor.

🐼 Slow Motion Replay
Tap the Panda button to replay movements in slow motion. Adjust the speed to learn at your own pace and refine each technique step by step.

⏩ Fast Forward & Rewind
Jump directly to any poses or stretches with easy navigation controls. Focus on specific movements without starting over.

🌄 Immersive Environments & Music

Choose from over 20 calming backgrounds — mountains, rivers, oceans, grasslands, and more. Each environment is paired with relaxing music to keep you centered and motivated. Switch instantly with just one tap.

🌟 Safety Note
Make sure you have enough space while using VR, move at your own pace, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable. This app is for instructional purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
